en.headline: Customs seizes HK$102 million of illicit tobacco in Kwai Chung and Kwu Tung
en.dek: Officers raided an export staging point and two packaging stores on Tuesday and arrested a local lorry driver, Customs said on Wednesday.
body: Hong Kong Customs said on Wednesday that officers had dismantled an illicit-tobacco export staging point in Kwai Chung and two packaging and storage sites in Kwu Tung, seizing goods with an estimated market value of about HK$102 million.

The haul, found on Tuesday, included about 12.8 million duty-not-paid cigarettes, 6,300 kilograms of manufactured tobacco, 14,000 alternative smoking products and 1,800 packs of smokeless tobacco, with a duty potential of about HK$67.65 million, according to figures given by Customs. Officers first stopped a lorry at a logistics warehouse in Kwai Chung and seized about 1.04 million cigarettes from the cargo bed, then searched two corrugated-iron compounds in Kwu Tung.

A local man described as a lorry driver was arrested. Customs officers said some manufactured tobacco had been packed to resemble pet feed for export, and that quiet tape had been used when cartons were rewrapped. The case is separate from a joint sea interception off Chek Lap Kok on the same day, in which about five million illicit cigarettes were seized from a high-powered speedboat.

zh.headline: 海關葵涌古洞搗三私煙點檢逾億元貨
zh.dek: 海關周二在葵涌物流倉及古洞兩個鐵皮場檢獲約1,280萬支未完稅香煙及6,300公斤煙草，市值約1.02億元，拘捕一名本地貨車司機。
body: 香港海關周三表示，人員周二在葵涌搗破一個私煙出口轉運點，並在古洞搜查兩個包裝及貯存場，檢獲市值約1.02億元的未完稅煙草產品。
海關公布，檢獲約1,280萬支未完稅香煙、6,300公斤製成煙草、1.4萬支另類吸煙產品及1,800盒無煙煙草產品，應課稅值約6,765萬元。人員先在葵涌一物流倉庫截查一輛貨車，在貨斗檢獲約104萬支香煙，其後再搜查古洞兩個鐵皮場。
一名報稱貨車司機的本地男子被捕。海關指部分製成煙草被偽裝成寵物飼料準備出口，重新包裝時亦使用消音膠紙。案件與同日在赤鱤角水域截獲快艇、檢約500萬支私煙的行動並非同一宗。
